feat(mysql): Support named `FOREIGN KEY` indexes. (#8615)

A MySQL `FOREIGN KEY` consists of an index and a constraint, both of
which may have different or similar names. MySQL's syntax accepts one or
no names for the `index_name` component, and either reuses an existing
index or generates a new one with a generated name:

```
ADD [CONSTRAINT [symbol]] FOREIGN KEY
      [index_name] (col_name,...)
      reference_definition
```

This commit adds support for parsing such an epression.
